target_customer: Health and wellness brands and retailers that want to accept HSA and FSA payments, and the shoppers who spend those funds
problem: Billions of dollars in HSA and FSA balances go unspent and merchants cannot easily accept those cards or qualify products as eligible.
business_model: Payments and marketplace take rate on HSA/FSA transactions plus consultation-based eligibility; exact fees not stated

founders.name: Sam O'Keefe
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page: product leadership at Unit21, Entrepreneur in Residence at Area 120, global head of startup programs at Google, TechCrunch editor.

founders.name: Miguel Toledo
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page: ML infrastructure at Lyft Level 5, fraud and AML products at Unit21, monitoring systems at Google Cloud.

competitors.name: Truemed
competitors.what: HSA/FSA checkout using letters of medical necessity, a Shopify payment integration

technical_complexity.rationale: Payment integration with card networks plus eligibility rules and medical necessity letters; the regulatory and processing integrations are harder than the front end.

defensibility.rationale: Merchant integrations and eligibility compliance accumulate, but Truemed and others offered a similar checkout.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acquisition or copy found in sources; direct startup competition from Truemed and Sika Health appears in later competitor lists.

market_need_then: The company cites about $150B per year in HSA and FSA funds, much of it unused, and later claims 2M+ orders and 5x customer growth in the year to September 2025 (company-reported).

branding.domain_note: Uses withflex.com, a prefix variant of the exact name, not flex.com which belongs to others.

identity.logo: Four logo variations listed in brand guidelines
identity.voice_and_tone: Savings-forward consumer copy: spend smarter with pre-tax money

branding.community_and_virality: Public brand guidelines and co-branding assets for merchants; partner announcements with Shiseido Americas and Clue in late 2025.

brand_strength.rationale: Name collides with Flex the manufacturer and other Flex products and the company uses withflex.com; the visible assets are partner badges rather than organic fan activity.

outcome_analysis: Flex raised a $3.2M seed in September 2024 and a $15M Series A co-led by First Round Capital and CoreVC in September 2025, with total capital about $18M. Founders with fraud and fintech product experience, a large pool of unspent HSA and FSA money and fast merchant growth drove the raise. Competition from Truemed remains, but no adverse events were found.
notes: Seed investors not named in the opened pymnts page. Series A press page showed only an update date of 2025-09-02; GlobeNewswire and Axios carry the same date. Totals across aggregators range from $18M to $18.7M. The company's blog thanks Y Combinator, Liquid2, SV Angel and Precursor as backers. Founder education not found.
